incumbent_comparison: Compared with v002, v003 materially improves the timber color and directional grain, and the integrated room captures retain the full asset at gameplay distance. The candidate stays inside the 25 x 19 x 23 inch authoritative envelope and now has directional grain. Its low crest/back relationship still diverges from the approved spindle-chair target, and the turned legs and joinery are represented by simple cylindrical members. No stable production incumbent exists, so v003 remains a best-current review candidate rather than a replacement.
next_action_hypothesis: Backlog this asset after its three approved-target attempts. Resume only with a production mesh workflow that authors shaped casework, turned or curved members, credible fitted joints and target-specific proportions; avoid another material-only loop.
